_about: Exam formula sheet (syllabus A5.2/B5: 'formula sheet provided for all exams'). Modules with a 'Core formulas' block (M4, M13–M16) are added automatically from the syllabus. The lines below are formulas used in the syllabus's own worked examples for the other modules, quoted with their location.

m0: Sample variance = Σ(x − mean)² / (n − 1); standard deviation = √variance
m5: Money-market yield = (Face / Price − 1) × 360 / t; bond-equivalent yield uses 365
m7: Market cap = shares × price; dividend yield = dividend / price
TERP = (n × share price + new shares × subscription price) / (n + new shares); value of a right = TERP − subscription price
Price-weighted index: sum of prices; cap-weighted: sum of price × shares; equal-weighted: average of returns
m8: Foreign investor's return = (1 + local return) × FX start / FX end − 1
m9: Futures gain/loss = change in points × multiplier × contracts
Call payoff = max(S − K, 0); put payoff = max(K − S, 0); profit = payoff − premium
Break-even: call K + premium; put K − premium
CDS premium = notional × spread; payout = notional × (1 − recovery)
m11: Net proceeds = gross proceeds − fees; first-day return = close / issue price − 1
m12: Margin-call price: (shares × P − loan) / (shares × P) = required equity
Netting reduction = 1 − shares moved net / gross shares
m17: Parametric VaR = value × z × σ; z(95%) = 1.645, z(99%) = 2.326
m19: Turnover ratio = annual value traded / average market capitalisation
